item.title: Retail Jeweller’s February 2026 issue out now
item.description: Retail Jeweller Retail Jeweller’s February 2026 issue out now The February 2026 issue of Retail Jeweller is out now and available to read online exclusively for subscribers. Retail Jeweller’s February 2026 issue out now Ruth Faulkner

item.title: WOLF introduces Seltzer colourway to Cub watch winder collection
item.description: Retail Jeweller WOLF introduces Seltzer colourway to Cub watch winder collection Watch accessories and leather goods brand WOLF has introduced a new Seltzer colourway to its popular Cub collection, bringing a fresh injection of modern colour to its watch winding and storage solutions. WOLF introduces Seltzer colourway to Cub watch winder collection Ruth Faulkner

item.title: IN PICS: Sif Jakobs Jewellery expands laboratory-grown diamond collection
item.description: Retail Jeweller IN PICS: Sif Jakobs Jewellery expands laboratory-grown diamond collection Sif Jakobs Jewellery has expanded its laboratory-grown diamond offering with a series of new designs crafted in 14k solid yellow and white gold. IN PICS: Sif Jakobs Jewellery expands laboratory-grown diamond collection Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Inhorgenta reveals details of 2026 content programme
item.description: Retail Jeweller Inhorgenta reveals details of 2026 content programme German trade show Inhorgenta has unveiled details of its 2026 content programme, underlining its position as a leading international platform for the jewellery, watch and gemstone industry. Inhorgenta reveals details of 2026 content programme Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Lily Gabriella unveils new website
item.description: Retail Jeweller Lily Gabriella unveils new website Eponymous fine jewellery deisgner Lily Gabriella has launched a new website for 2026, revealing her latest collections and a series of new jewellery designs while reinforcing the brand’s growing focus on bespoke craftsmanship. Lily Gabriella unveils new website Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Gemfields operational update shows solid auction revenues and progress at Montepuez
item.description: Retail Jeweller Gemfields operational update shows solid auction revenues and progress at Montepuez Gemfields has published an operational update covering performance to 31 December 2025 for its 75%-owned Kagem emerald mine and 75%-owned Montepuez ruby mine, reporting strong auction revenues and ongoing progress at its second processing plant. Gemfields operational update shows solid auction revenues and progress at Montepuez Ruth Faulkner

item.title: CMJ outlines new invoicing and data system at supplier conference
item.description: Retail Jeweller CMJ outlines new invoicing and data system at supplier conference The Company of Master Jewellers (CMJ) has outlined plans for a new invoicing and data management system during its second Supplier Member Conference, held at The Belfry Hotel and Resort on 29 January 2026. CMJ outlines new invoicing and data system at supplier conference Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Coeur de Lion reveals SS26 collections
item.description: Retail Jeweller Coeur de Lion reveals SS26 collections German fashion jewellery brand Coeur de Lion has unveiled its latest ranges for the SS26 season. Coeur de Lion reveals SS26 collections Ruth Faulkner

item.title: INDUSTRY Q&A: What to expect at Inhorgenta 2026
item.description: Retail Jeweller INDUSTRY Q&A: What to expect at Inhorgenta 2026 Ahead of the 2026 edition of German trade show Inhorgenta, which takes place from February 20-23, Retail Jeweller caught up with exhibition director Stefanie Mändlein to find out what visitors to the show can expect this year. INDUSTRY Q&A: What to expect at Inhorgenta 2026 Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Howard Levine launches Trade SafeGuard
item.description: Retail Jeweller Howard Levine launches Trade SafeGuard A new private industry platform, Trade SafeGuard, has officially launched with the aim of giving jewellery and diamond suppliers earlier visibility, fewer commercial surprises and improved decision-making across the trade. Howard Levine launches Trade SafeGuard Ruth Faulkner
